title: Staying Well: Health, Habits and Public Services

words.exam_focus_zh: 听力与阅读的健康类文章中常作动词表示“感染（疾病）”，重音在后；作名词“合同”时重音在前 /ˈkɒntrækt/，考试常借重音差别设陷阱。

senses.definition_en: to catch or become infected with an illness
to become smaller or tighter, especially of muscles or an economy
a formal written agreement between two parties

synonyms.nuance_zh: 口语常用，非正式场合更自然（catch a cold）；contract 更正式，多用于书面和学术语境的疾病名称前。
强调体积或数量变小，不及物用法更常见；contract 还可指肌肉主动收缩，较正式。

examples.sentence: Children who contract the virus usually recover within a week, but they can still pass it on to vulnerable relatives.
examples.translation_zh: 感染这种病毒的孩子通常一周内康复，但仍可能传染给易感的家人。
examples.note_zh: 阅读中 contract 作动词是“感染”，不要误读成“合同”。

examples.sentence: During the winter months, the number of people who contract flu rises sharply, putting extra strain on local clinics.
examples.translation_zh: 冬季感染流感的人数急剧上升，给当地诊所带来额外压力。
examples.note_zh: 健康类段落常把 contract 与 strain 等词放在一起考搭配。

words.exam_focus_zh: 写作 Task 2 中用来替换 reduce/ease 的高分动词，常与表示痛苦、压力、贫困等负面名词搭配；阅读中常被同义替换为 ease 或 relieve。

senses.definition_en: to make pain or an unpleasant feeling less severe
to make a problem or difficult situation less serious

synonyms.nuance_zh: 更强调直接“解除”痛苦，搭配范围更广（relieve stress/pain）；alleviate 更正式书面，常见于政策与医学论述。
语体偏中性，可指压力、拥堵等逐步缓和；alleviate 更正式，多用于症状、贫困、负担等较严肃的对象。

examples.sentence: Planting trees along busy roads can help alleviate the effects of air pollution in densely built-up areas.
examples.translation_zh: 在繁忙道路旁种树有助于减轻密集城区空气污染的影响。
examples.note_zh: 写作中 alleviate 后接 effects、pressure、burden 等负面名词最自然。

examples.sentence: The government introduced subsidies to alleviate the financial burden on low-income households.
examples.translation_zh: 政府推出补贴，以减轻低收入家庭的经济负担。
examples.note_zh: 阅读同义替换常把 alleviate 改写为 reduce 或 ease。

words.exam_focus_zh: 阅读中常被同义替换为 widespread 或 common，写作里用于描述某种现象“日益普遍”，是健康与社会类话题的高频形容词。

senses.definition_en: existing very commonly or happening often in a particular place or time

synonyms.nuance_zh: 强调分布范围广，常用于看法、现象、使用的扩散；prevalent 更强调在某群体或某时期内“常见”。
synonyms.collocation: widespread use of technology（技术的广泛使用）

synonyms.nuance_zh: 最通用的口语词；prevalent 更正式，适合学术写作与数据分析语境。

collocations.phrase: prevalent among young adults（在年轻人中普遍）
collocations.meaning_zh: 在某个群体中广泛存在

examples.sentence: The survey found that sleep problems were most prevalent among people working night shifts.
examples.translation_zh: 该调查发现，睡眠问题在上夜班的人群中最为普遍。
examples.note_zh: prevalent among + 人群 是阅读和写作都常用的结构。

examples.sentence: As desk-based jobs have become more prevalent, rates of back pain have continued to climb.
examples.translation_zh: 随着伏案工作日益普遍，背痛的发病率持续上升。
examples.note_zh: 写作中可用 increasingly prevalent 描述趋势，避免重复 popular。

words.exam_focus_zh: 阅读健康类文章常与 vulnerable、prone 构成同义替换；固定搭配 be susceptible to + 名词，写作中用来指出某群体更易受影响。

senses.definition_en: likely to be affected by something, especially an illness or a bad influence
easily harmed or influenced because of a lack of protection

synonyms.nuance_zh: 强调缺乏保护，常指人群或系统；susceptible 更侧重“身体或条件上容易受到某具体因素影响”，常接 to。
多指行为或性格倾向（prone to error），也可指易患某病；susceptible 更中性客观，学术味更浓。

collocations.phrase: be susceptible to infection（易受感染）

collocations.meaning_zh: 非常容易受影响或感染

examples.sentence: Older adults and young children are especially susceptible to dehydration in hot weather.
examples.translation_zh: 老年人和幼儿在炎热天气中尤其容易脱水。
examples.note_zh: be susceptible to + 名词 是固定搭配，介词不能换成 for。

examples.sentence: People who regularly sleep fewer than six hours appear more susceptible to infection.
examples.translation_zh: 经常睡眠不足六小时的人似乎更容易受到感染。
examples.note_zh: 写作中用来说明某类人群风险更高，可替代 likely to get。

words.exam_focus_zh: 写作中 put a strain on 是描述公共资源压力的高频搭配；听力健康场景又常作动词“拉伤”，一词多义易在选择题中设干扰。

senses.definition_en: pressure on a person, system or resource that makes it difficult to cope
an injury caused by stretching a muscle too much
to put pressure on something, or to injure a muscle by stretching it

synonyms.nuance_zh: 更泛，可指心理或物理压力；strain 强调因长期负荷而“吃紧”，多用于医疗、交通、财政等系统。
强调重量与责任，常与 financial、economic 搭配；strain 更强调承受方的紧张状态。

collocations.phrase: put a strain on public services（给公共服务带来压力）

collocations.meaning_zh: 使肌肉过度拉伸而受伤

examples.sentence: An ageing population places a growing strain on hospitals and care services.
examples.translation_zh: 人口老龄化给医院和护理服务带来越来越大的压力。
examples.note_zh: place/put a strain on 是 Task 2 讨论公共资源的固定句式。

examples.sentence: Runners who increase their weekly distance too quickly often strain muscles in the lower leg.
examples.translation_zh: 每周跑量增加过快的跑者常会拉伤小腿肌肉。
examples.note_zh: 听力健康场景中 strain 作动词表“拉伤”，注意与名词义区分。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: You look exhausted. Are you coming down with something?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I hope not. Three people in my office have contracted the same bug this week.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: It seems really prevalent this winter. My sister's whole class was off last week.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm not surprised. We all sit in the same meeting room with the windows shut.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Maybe that's why the manager sent round an email about ventilation. Apparently fresh air helps alleviate the headaches people were complaining about.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Good luck with that. I doubt an open window will fix the real problem — the workload is putting a huge strain on everyone.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: True. And the people most susceptible to stress are usually the ones who never say no.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Exactly. I'm trying to leave on time now, even if it means answering a few emails at home.

quiz.question: Regular exercise and enough sleep can help ____ the symptoms of mild stress.
quiz.explanation_zh: alleviate 意为“缓解（症状、痛苦）”，与 symptoms 搭配最自然。contract 是“感染”，strain 作动词是“拉伤/使紧张”，prevalent 是形容词，都不能填入动词位置。

quiz.question: In the reading passage, 'children are more vulnerable to the infection' could best be rewritten as:
options: children are more susceptible to the infection
children are more prevalent among the infection
children are more strained by the infection
children are more contracted by the infection
quiz.explanation_zh: be susceptible to 与 be vulnerable to 都可表示“易受……影响”，是雅思阅读常见的同义替换。prevalent 是“普遍的”，不能接 among the infection；strained 指“紧张的”；contract 是主动感染，不能用被动加 by。

review.question: Complete the sentence: 'The city invested heavily in public ____, such as roads, drainage systems and power lines.'
Rewrite using a word from your review list: 'The new bus lanes have reduced traffic jams in the city centre.'
review.answer: The new bus lanes have reduced traffic congestion in the city centre.
